## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Deliverable is complete and reproducible/verifiable.
- [ ] Primary evidence/source-of-truth links are included.
- [ ] External relationship/adoption claims do not exceed the evidence.
- [ ] Tests or equivalent validation are provided when applicable.
- [ ] No duplicate bounty exists for the same deliverable.
- [ ] No secrets, private keys, seed phrases, credentials or unnecessary personal data are committed.

## Evidence

List the required evidence, for example:

- MyZubster PR/commit;
- upstream PR/issue and review status;
- tests/benchmark/reproducible output;
- sanitized screenshot/report;
- official LIFE/program source;
- SHA-256/CID for sanitized public artifacts where useful.

A CID proves content identity, not truth or acceptance.

## Track-specific safety gate

### LIFE
- [ ] Official sources are used for call/eligibility/deadline facts.
- [ ] No invented partner, budget, KPI, approval, consortium or funding claim.

### Aruba
- [ ] Work is framed as independent unless relationship evidence exists.
- [ ] No support tickets, customer data, employee identities, private IPs, credentials or infrastructure secrets.

### Metasploit
- [ ] Target/environment is explicitly authorized.
- [ ] No destructive testing, persistence, credential theft, DoS or third-party targeting.

### Monero
- [ ] Upstream contribution rules are respected.
- [ ] No mainnet custody/exchange/escrow/payment activation is authorized by this bounty.

### Metaverse / WebXR
- [ ] Upstream licensing/contribution rules are respected.
- [ ] `fork != acceptance`, `PR != integration`, `integration != partnership/adoption`.

## Settlement boundary

Issue creation, claim, PR, CI success, merge, upstream merge or issue closure does **not** by itself prove external payment. `PAID` requires independent settlement evidence appropriate to the rail.
